title: Scheduled Restocking Visits on the Vending Services Program
content:
Scheduled restocking visits to a Vending Services Program estate are made the number of times each week printed against the programme the agreement is written at, and each scheduled visit runs for the length printed against the same programme.

| Programme | Scheduled restocking visits each week | Length of each scheduled visit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | 1 | 0.5 hours |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | 1 | 1.0 hours |
| Combination Vending Bank | 2 | 1.5 hours |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | 4 | 2.0 hours |
| Campus Vending Network Service | 5 | 5.0 hours |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | 5 | 3.5 hours |

The visit count is a whole number of visits each week to the estate as a whole, not to each machine. The visit length is stated in hours to one decimal place and is the length of one scheduled visit.

### The weekly restocking time the schedule yields (hypothetical arithmetic)

The two figures are read together where the question is how much restocking time an estate is written for in a week. On the Combination Vending Bank, 2 visits each week of 1.5 hours each come to 3.0 hours of scheduled restocking in the week. On the Campus Vending Network Service, 5 visits of 5.0 hours each come to 25.0 hours, and on the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service, 5 visits of 3.5 hours each come to 17.5 hours. The two smallest programmes are each written for a single visit a week, of 0.5 hours on the Single Machine Snack Service and 1.0 hours on the Snack & Cold Beverage Bank.
